tools.name: sk_flights_search
tools.description: Search Skiplagged for flights between specific locations with filtering options for passengers, fare class, stops, airlines, and timing preferences

additionalOrigins.description: Up to two additional departure cities or airport codes

additionalDestinations.description: Up to two additional arrival cities or airport codes

limit.description: Maximum number of flights to return (default: 12, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of flights to skip (default: 0); limit + offset must not exceed 100

sort.description: Sort flights by price (cheapest first), duration (shortest first), or value (best price/time ratio, default)

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

maxStops.description: Maximum number of stops (none=nonstop, one=1 stop, many=2+ stops)

departureTimeEarliest.description: Earliest departure time in minutes from midnight (0-1439)

departureTimeLatest.description: Latest departure time in minutes from midnight (0-1439)

arrivalTimeEarliest.description: Earliest arrival time in minutes from midnight (0-1439)

arrivalTimeLatest.description: Latest arrival time in minutes from midnight (0-1439)

maxFlightDuration.description: Maximum total flight duration in minutes

departureAirports.description: Array of specific departure airport codes to include (when origin city has multiple airports)

arrivalAirports.description: Array of specific arrival airport codes to include (when destination city has multiple airports)

tools.name: sk_destinations_anywhere
tools.description: Find lower-priced destinations from a departure city when the user is flexible about where to go.

from.description: Departure IATA code or city name

return.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional for one-way trips)

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

tools.name: sk_flex_departure_calendar
tools.description: Generate a flexible calendar of the lowest one-way fares around a chosen departure, returning date → cheapest-price entries to help pick the best day to fly. Intended for flexible-date price discovery, not exact itinerary selection.

origin.description: Departure city name or IATA code (will be resolved to IATA code automatically)

destination.description: Arrival city name or IATA code (will be resolved to IATA code automatically)

returnDate.description: Return date for matching trip length (optional, YYYY-MM-DD format)

sort.description: Sort results chronologically or by lowest price first

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

tools.name: sk_flex_return_calendar
tools.description: Generate a flexible round-trip price calendar for a fixed-length stay around a chosen travel window. Returns (depart date, return date, lowest total price) entries for nearby date pairs that preserve the original trip length; intended for price discovery, not exact itinerary selection.

origin.description: Departure city name or IATA code (will be resolved to IATA code automatically)

destination.description: Arrival city name or IATA code (will be resolved to IATA code automatically)

returnDate.description: Return date for the reference trip (YYYY-MM-DD format)

sort.description: Sort results chronologically or by lowest price first

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

tools.name: sk_hotels_search
tools.description: Search Skiplagged for hotels in a city with specific check-in and check-out dates, including ratings and pricing.

city.description: City name to search for hotels (will be matched against available cities)

limit.description: Maximum number of hotels to return (default: 12, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of hotels to skip (default: 0); limit + offset must not exceed 100

sort.description: Sort hotels by price (cheapest first), ranking (highest rated first), value (best value rating), or discount (best deals first, default when deals available)

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

tools.name: sk_cars_search
tools.description: Search Skiplagged for rental cars between pickup and dropoff locations/dates, returning prices, companies, and car details.

dropoffLocation.description: Dropoff city or airport code (defaults to pickup)

limit.description: Maximum number of car offers to return

offset.description: Number of car offers to skip (default: 0); limit + offset must not exceed 100

tools.name: sk_award_search
tools.description: Search award seats: flights bookable with airline miles or loyalty points (Aeroplan, Alaska Mileage Plan, Flying Blue, Delta SkyMiles, United MileagePlus, Virgin Atlantic, Qantas, Emirates, Qatar and more), with the miles and cash taxes/fees each costs. Use it when the user wants to use miles or points; use sk_flights_search for cash fares. Flexible by design: origins and destinations take several airport codes, metro codes (NYC, LON) or region slugs (europe, japan, california); destinations can be empty for anywhere. Dates can be one day (departureDate), a window (departureDate + departureDateEnd), give or take N days (flexibleDays), or left out to search every date with seats loaded (about the next 60 days). Set returnDate or roundTrip for return awards, listed separately (awards are booked one way). Each result is the cheapest program for that route, date and cabin, per traveler; filter `programs` for the price in a specific program. Book on the program site; `searchUrl` opens the same search on Skiplagged.

origins.description: Where to fly from: airport codes (JFK), metro codes (NYC, LON, which search every airport of the city), or place slugs for a US state, country or continent (california, united-kingdom, japan, europe, asia, north-america, south-america, africa, oceania). Several allowed, e.g. ['JFK', 'EWR']. Resolve a city name you have no code for with sk_resolve_iata first.

destinations.description: Where to fly to, in the same forms as origins, e.g. ['europe'] or ['LHR', 'CDG']. Empty searches anywhere (slow and broad; prefer a region).

departureDate.description: Exact departure date (YYYY-MM-DD), or the first day of a window ending on departureDateEnd. Omit to search every date with seats loaded (about the next 60 days).

departureDateEnd.description: Last departure day of a window (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); needs departureDate. E.g. departureDate 2026-12-01 and departureDateEnd 2026-12-15 for "the first half of December".

returnDate.description: Exact return date (YYYY-MM-DD), or the first day of a return window ending on returnDateEnd. Setting it makes the search a round trip.

returnDateEnd.description: Last return day of a window (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive); needs returnDate.

roundTrip.description: Also search return awards (default: false; implied by returnDate). Without return dates, returns are searched up to 14 days after the last departure day, or over every loaded date for a dateless search.

flexibleDays.description: Also search this many days before and after each date or window (default: 0), e.g. 3 for "give or take 3 days".

cabins.description: Cabins to search (default: ['economy']); premium is premium economy. Several allowed, e.g. ['business', 'first'].

seats.description: Travelers who need a seat (default: 1, max: 9; lap infants need none). Only awards with this many seats left are returned.

programs.description: Only awards bookable with these loyalty programs, e.g. when the user holds Aeroplan points. Omit for every program: aeroplan (Air Canada Aeroplan), alaska (Alaska Mileage Plan), delta (Delta SkyMiles), emirates (Emirates Skywards), etihad (Etihad Guest), flyingblue (Air France-KLM Flying Blue), jetblue (JetBlue TrueBlue), qantas (Qantas Frequent Flyer), qatar (Qatar Airways Privilege Club), united (United MileagePlus), velocity (Virgin Australia Velocity), virginatlantic (Virgin Atlantic Flying Club).

airlines.description: Only awards flown by these airlines (IATA codes, e.g. ['BA', 'VS'])

maxMiles.description: Only awards costing at most this many miles per traveler

sort.description: Order awards by fewest miles (then fees, default) or by earliest date

limit.description: Maximum awards to return per direction (default: 12, max: 50)

offset.description: Number of awards to skip per direction (default: 0); limit + offset must not exceed 100

currency.description: Currency to show taxes and fees in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it. Fees are converted and approximate; miles are unaffected.

tools.name: sk_hotel_details
tools.description: Fetch room-level availability, pricing, and amenities for a specific hotel and stay dates.

hotelId.description: Hotel ID (from search results) to fetch detailed availability for

live.description: Use live rates (includes booking links). Disable for faster, less accurate cached rates.

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

tools.name: sk_faq_search
tools.description: Search Skiplagged support articles for answers about its services, products, and policies.

query.description: Concise FAQ question for retrieval. Do not include personal identifiers, account IDs, or session details.

top_k.description: Number of top FAQ sources to return (1-5)

tools.name: sk_resolve_location
tools.description: Resolve coarse location metadata supplied by the client to the nearest airport. Takes no user-provided arguments.

tools.name: sk_resolve_iata
tools.description: Resolve a city name to an IATA code, or pass through a three-letter code

input.description: City name code to resolve to IATA code
